explanation: An Israelite king who ruled in the northern kingdom of Israel and wiped out Ahab's family.
A former Israelite king who was married to Jezebel and worshipped Baal, a false god.
Ahab's wife, an evil queen who promoted idolatry and persecuted God's prophets.
A false god worshipped by the Canaanites and other nations, often associated with fertility and rain.
The capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel at that time.
A holy place where people worshipped gods, including both the true God and false gods.
A person chosen by God to deliver His message and guide His people.
An agreement or covenant between two parties, often between God and His people.
To completely destroy or remove something, especially an entire family or group of people.
